title: Fermat's Last Theorem (FLT): Elliptic n-Torsion & Compact Hausdorff Groups
description: Two genuine, non-PR-conflicted standalone Mathlib open `sorry` theorems copied verbatim from Imperial College London's Fermat's Last Theorem formalization (ImperialCollegeLondon/FLT@01980581, Apache-2.0), verified verbatim on Lean v4.36.0 + Mathlib v4.36.0: rank-2 structure of the n-torsion subgroup of an elliptic curve over a separably closed field (`WeierstrassCurve.torsion_rank_two`, Kevin Buzzard) and triviality of connected compact Hausdorff `𝔽_p`-vector spaces (`Group.subsingleton_of_pow_prime_eq_one`, Thomas Browning & Kevin Buzzard).

tasks.title: Prove n-torsion of an elliptic curve over a separably closed field is (ℤ/nℤ)²
tasks.description: Closes the open `sorry` at `FLT/KnownIn1980s/EllipticCurves/Torsion.lean:36-38` (`WeierstrassCurve.torsion_rank_two`): for an elliptic curve `E` over a separably closed field `k` and `n : ℕ` nonzero in `k`, prove `Nonempty (AddSubgroup.torsionBy (E⁄k).Point (n : ℤ) ≃+ (ZMod n) × (ZMod n))` with 0 sorry and standard axioms only.

tasks.title: Prove connected compact Hausdorff abelian group of prime exponent p is trivial
tasks.description: Closes the open `sorry` at `FLT/Patching/Utils/CompactHausdorffRings.lean:37-42` (`Group.subsingleton_of_pow_prime_eq_one`): prove every connected compact Hausdorff abelian topological group `A` satisfying `∀ a : A, a ^ p = 1` for prime `p` is a `Subsingleton` (from which FLT already derives total disconnectedness of compact Hausdorff rings), with 0 sorry and standard axioms only.
